name: The Other Umbrella
tagline: An umbrella to keep at work. It won't help if you're at home.
summary: A compact umbrella with a tag for hanging it in a desk drawer or on a hook at work. Sky blue with one pink panel. £22.
concept: A compact umbrella with a strong frame and a canopy that dries quickly. It comes with a tag so you can leave it at work.
why_it_exists: The umbrella is always at home on the days it rains at work. This is the second one.
target_customer: People who commute and keep getting caught out.

physical.form: A compact manual umbrella with a straight handle, a folding frame and a protective sleeve.
physical.dimensions: Folded: 28 cm long. Open: 98 cm across.

features: It folds down to 28 cm, so it fits in a bag or a desk drawer.
It opens 98 cm across, wide enough to cover you and your shoulders.
Eight fibreglass ribs keep it strong in the wind.
It comes with a tag, so you can write your name on it and leave it at work for rainy days.
The sleeve has a hanging loop, so you can hang it on a hook.
arrives: The umbrella comes in its sleeve inside a brown card sleeve, with the desk-drawer tag tucked in. There is no plastic. The parcel is a slim box, and the umbrella is ready to use when you open it.
specs: Folded: 28 cm long. Open: 98 cm across.
Recycled polyester canopy, fibreglass ribs, rubberised handle
Sky blue with one pink panel
Open it to dry before folding it away. Wipe with a damp cloth.
how_it_works: Slide the runner up to open it and press it down to close it. Put it in its sleeve, write your name on the tag and leave it at work.

compatibility.note: No compact umbrella copes with it. Fold it and go indoors.

packaging: A kraft card sleeve. No plastic.

warranty.summary: It has a 12-month warranty against faults in how it was made. A frame bent by wind is not a fault. See Warranty.

care: Open it to dry before folding it away.
Wipe the canopy with a damp cloth.
safety: Do not use it in lightning.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

repairs.name: Rib or canopy repair (quoted after assessment)

page.headline: An umbrella to keep at work
page.intro: An umbrella to keep at work. It won't help if you're at home.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A compact umbrella, 28 cm folded and 98 cm across when open. Sky blue with one pink panel. £22.

sections.title: The tag
sections.body: Write your name on the tag and leave the umbrella in a drawer or on a hook.

sections.title: Repairs
sections.body: The Fix Club repairs ribs and canopies. The price is quoted after assessment.

faq.q: Why is it called The Other Umbrella?
faq.a: It is meant to be the second one, kept at work.
28 cm folded and 98 cm across open.
No. You open it by hand.
It copes with ordinary wind. A frame bent by strong wind is not a fault.
Yes. The Fix Club repairs ribs and canopies. The price is quoted after assessment.
Yes, within 30 days, if it is unused and in its packaging.

troubleshooting.problem: It will not open or close smoothly.
steps: Open it fully and wipe the runner with a dry cloth.
Check no fabric is caught in the ribs.
Close it gently and stop using it in strong wind.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: The Fix Club can repair it. Open a support case for a quote.

photography_direction: A closed and an open umbrella. Clean colour, a visible desk tag. No rain, no models.
